transport: one shared WebSocket, no compression, max_queue=16, max_size=2 MiB
method: strict match of market, event-time string and Decimal best prices AND sizes; receipt before JSON decode
limitations: Local application receipt includes scheduling, prior-frame parsing and shared TCP head-of-line effects.
This is not exchange publication latency, wire arrival time or an independent-connection comparison.
Only matched states are comparable; unmatched updates may bias the subset.
Duplicates are suppressed within a bounded 5-second/10000-event window; each market retains at most 100000 samples.

price_transition_observation.method: same preceding and next best bid/ask prices; transition occurs exactly once in each channel over the whole sample; receipt gap <=1s; sizes/timestamps not matched
price_transition_observation.limitation: Heuristic visibility of sampled price transitions, NOT proof of the same exchange event. Skipped/repeated changes and unmatched paths bias the subset.
